weather_summary: Sunnyvale forecast looks dry and mild: roughly mid-to-upper 70s with little to no rain. San Jose is also dry, around the low-to-mid 70s depending on source. Morning outdoor festivals, markets, and open-streets plans are reasonable; keep hats, water, and indoor library/museum backups for crowds or stroller fatigue.

events.title: Silicon Valley Fall Fest
events.label: Best overall
events.cost: Free admission and free parking; food and purchases optional
events.food: Food trucks, festival snacks, craft beverage area for adults, and nearby Cupertino food
events.why: The strongest fit this weekend: very close to Sunnyvale, free, daytime, with Kids Zone, Bike Rodeo, pony rides, petting zoo, giant slides, animal show, food trucks, cultural booths, parade, and family activities.
events.sourceName: Silicon Valley Fall Fest / City of Cupertino

events.title: Google Endless Summer Festival
events.label: Free activity fest
events.food: Cafe treats, mocktails, seasonal menu items, nearby Mountain View options
events.why: Free all-ages outdoor celebration with family DJs, magic, crafts, sports activities, slime truck, chalk art, mini market, sweet treats, and giveaways.

events.title: Sunnyvale Farmers' Market + Family Storytime
events.label: Closest morning
events.time: Sat, Sep 12, market 9:00 AM-1:00 PM; Family Storytime 11:00 AM
events.place: Downtown Sunnyvale and Sunnyvale Public Library
events.food: Market fruit, pastries, coffee, prepared foods, and Murphy Avenue restaurants
events.why: Lowest-friction local plan: market snacks first, then a free indoor family storytime if the toddler wants structure or shade.

events.title: Mountain View Art & Wine Festival
events.label: Big local festival
events.time: Sat, Sep 12, 11:00 AM-7:00 PM; Sun, Sep 13, 10:00 AM-6:00 PM
events.cost: Free admission; food, drinks, and purchases optional
events.food: Gourmet street food, Castro Street restaurants, snacks, nonalcoholic drinks, and adult tasting options
events.why: A major close-to-home festival with Kid Zone, face painting, games, bungee trampolines, food, art, music, and family activity areas. Go early Sunday for better toddler pacing.

events.title: Sunnyvale Mid-Autumn Festival Storytime and Craft
events.label: Sunday indoor
events.cost: Free; no registration listed, space limited
events.food: Downtown Sunnyvale snacks or early dinner nearby
events.why: Short, free, culturally themed storytime and craft for ages 3+ and caregivers. Good Sunday indoor reset after bigger Saturday options.

events.title: Viva CalleSJ: Into the Valley
events.label: Open streets
events.place: South San Jose route with hubs at Martial Cottle Park, De Anza Park, and Cahalan Park
events.food: Route-adjacent local businesses and activity hubs; pack water and snacks
events.why: Car-free streets are excellent for stroller walks, balance bikes, and short toddler exploration. Choose one activity hub rather than trying the full route.

events.title: Cultura In The Park
events.label: Culture + food
events.place: Plaza de San Jose, San Jose
events.food: Local food vendors and downtown San Jose restaurants
events.why: Free community celebration with live music, cultural performances, free kids activities, food vendors, wellness activities, and community resources.

events.title: Environmental Education Center Open House
events.label: Nature backup
events.food: Pack snacks; Cupertino cafes and Main Street are nearby after
events.why: Animal ambassadors, preserve staff, local ecology, and hands-on nature activities make this a reliable free toddler-friendly nature option.

events.title: SJPL Family Storytime & Stay and Play
events.label: Free toddler program
events.food: Branch-area coffee/lunch; pack snacks if timing is tight
events.why: A clean indoor 0-5 rhythm: stories, songs, and stay-and-play in a short nap-friendly block.

events.title: SJPL Music and Movement
events.label: Songs + movement
events.place: Educational Park Branch Library, San Jose
events.food: Plan nearby snacks or lunch after
events.why: Movement-oriented storytime is a better toddler fit than quiet-only library programming, and the timing protects the nap window.

events.title: Mountain View Mid-Autumn Festival Story Celebration
events.label: Library culture
events.place: Mountain View Public Library, Mountain View
events.food: Castro Street cafes and lunch nearby
events.why: Nearby indoor story celebration for ages 3-12; good if Mountain View Art & Wine feels too crowded or too exposed.
events.sourceName: FamHop / Mountain View Public Library listing

events.title: San Jose Book Festival
events.label: Book day
events.time: Sat, Sep 12; check festival schedule for hours
events.cost: Festival details vary; verify schedule before leaving
events.food: Downtown San Jose food nearby
events.why: Family-friendly literary festival with local authors and book-centered programming. Stronger if paired with downtown food or library time.

events.title: Salsa Fest San Jose & Foodie Bonanza
events.label: Food + music
events.cost: Ticketed; children 10 and under free per organizer
events.food: Foodie Bonanza vendors and downtown restaurants
events.why: Good food-and-culture outing if you go early and briefly. Late timing and music volume make it less toddler-safe than morning festivals.

events.title: SHD FitFest
events.label: Wellness fair
events.cost: Registration listed; likely free or low cost, verify before leaving
events.food: Healthy food and drinks listed; downtown Sunnyvale nearby
events.why: Close Sunnyvale wellness event with dancing, fitness demos, DJ sets, resource fair, food, and community energy. Better for families who want movement rather than a toddler-specific program.

events.title: Join-A-Ranger: IDs for the Trees
events.label: Short nature hike
events.time: Sun, Sep 13; registration required, check city schedule
events.food: Pack snacks; Cupertino food nearby afterward
events.why: A short ranger-led tree ID activity at McClellan Ranch. Best for preschoolers who can handle a guided walk; less ideal for a very young toddler stroller day.

events.title: Mountain View Farmers Market
events.label: Sunday market
events.place: Downtown Mountain View Caltrain Station parking lot
events.food: Growers, prepared food vendors, coffee, and Castro Street restaurants
events.why: Reliable Sunday food walk with transit access, easy stroller movement, and flexible snack pacing.

events.title: Santa Clara Farmers Market
events.label: Saturday market
events.place: Jackson Street and Homestead Road, Santa Clara
events.food: Produce, prepared foods, juice, coffee, and Santa Clara lunch nearby
events.why: Close, simple, and snack-friendly with a clean morning window and an easy exit before nap.

events.title: Campbell Farmers Market
events.label: Brunch market
events.food: Market snacks, bakeries, coffee, and downtown Campbell brunch
events.why: A strong food-forward South Bay market walk with compact downtown stroller flow.

events.title: California Avenue Farmers Market
events.label: Palo Alto snacks
events.food: Market produce, baked goods, coffee, and California Ave restaurants
events.why: Good northbound food walk if Palo Alto already fits the day; flexible and easy to cut short.

events.title: The Little Gym Fall Fest Parent Survival Night
events.label: Ages 3+ drop-off
events.food: Mountain View / El Camino food nearby
events.why: Good for age 3+ kids who can separate, but not a toddler-first family adventure because it is paid, evening, and drop-off oriented.

events.title: Broadway San Jose: Disney's Beauty and the Beast
events.label: Older-kid show
events.place: Center for the Performing Arts, San Jose
events.food: Downtown San Jose food before or after
events.why: Family-friendly title, but cost, duration, seat time, and show etiquette make it better for older kids than toddlers.
events.sourceName: Visit San Jose / Broadway San Jose
events.sourceType: city event calendar and primary ticketing cross-check
